units: Ruth R. s. 1 end וילך איש ג׳ ‘and a man went’ (Ruth I, 1)—a stump, i.e. without any description as to what he took with him (opp. to the description of the return to Palestine, Ezra II, 66); [Yalk. Ezra 1067 גָּדוּד, v. גָּדַד; ib. Ruth 598 גָּרוּד stripped, alone, cmp. גְּרֵירָא.]—Pl. גַּרְדּוּמִין, constr. גַּרְדּוּמֵי.
Tosef. Par. XII (XI), 2 ג׳ אזוב stumped stalks of hyssop; ג׳ ציצית (not ניצית); Men. 38ᵇ ג׳ תבלת remnant of the tsitsith.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 115:2">Sifré Num. 115</cite> <he>שיריה וגַרְדּוּמֶיהָ</he> what is left of it or the stump of it; <cite ref="Menachot 39a:3">Men. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>שיריו וגַרְדּוּמָיו</he>, expl.
<cite ref="Menachot 39a:5">ibid.</cite> <he>דבעינן שירא לגרדומיו</he> a small remnant of the threads must remain on the stumps; a. e.
